attacks.attack: A later post-freeze Task 13/source-only challenge attacked the assertion that distinct smooth right inverses of one configuration extraction map must induce different pullback metrics, and recomputed the Fisher metric for constant and diagonal lifts of the same normal location extraction.
attacks.response: The attack is sustained. For N((theta,eta),I2), pi(theta,eta)=theta, and Fisher metric dtheta^2+deta^2, the distinct constant lifts iota_0(x)=(x,0) and iota_c(x)=(x,c) both pull back to dx^2, while iota_Delta(x)=(x,x) pulls back to 2dx^2. The sharp boundary is that distinct right inverses can, but need not, differ; in general a pullback construction must declare its lift unless a separate uniqueness, canonicity, or lift-independence theorem is proved. This finding is not attributed to the historical Task 12 G oracle packet. A follow-up independent source-only semantic audit APPROVED the exact-current repair bytes.
